question: What simplified rite brings success after abandoning the earlier ritual elements?
premises: The earlier ritual elements are to be abandoned here.
Success comes through worship in a vessel of good wine, focusing on the thin one in the middle.
This rite may be performed through day and night and continued on the next day.
inference: After setting aside the elaborate implements, one attains success by performing this central worship in good wine, continuing it day and night and into the next day.
uncertainties: The identity of 'kṛśāṃ' (the thin one) is not specified in the verse.
The exact ritual role of the vessel of wine is context-dependent.
plain_english: Having abandoned those things here, one attains success by worshipping the thin one in the middle, in a vessel of good wine. One should perform this rite day and night, and continue it on the following day.
